quote: Except as regards the products covered by the Annex to Regulation (EU)No 995/2010, for operators, whether natural persons or micro- or small undertakings within the meaning of Article 3(1) or Article 3(2), first subparagraph, respectively, of Directive 2013/34/EU, irrespective of their legal form, who were established as such by 31 December 2024, the Articles referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article shall apply from 30 June 2027.
caveat: This applies if your company was already small by 31 December 2024. Timber products already covered by the EU Timber Regulation (No 995/2010) are left out of this postponement and keep the general date, 30 December 2026.

quote: Subject to paragraph 3 of this Article, Articles 3 to 13, Articles 16 to 24 and Articles 26, 31 and 32 shall apply from 30 December 2026.
